status.summary: Former two-time UFC middleweight champion on a four-fight losing streak: Strickland (UD, Sep 2023), Du Plessis (RNC, Aug 2024), Imavov (TKO, Feb 2025), Joe Pyfer (TKO R2, UFC Seattle, Mar 28, 2026). Pro record 24-6. He rejected retirement, split with City Kickboxing in July 2026 after 17 years and now prepares with a smaller team built around him, including sessions at Freestyle MMA in Sydney (Sep 2026). He is widely reported to headline UFC Fight Night 295 in Riyadh on Dec 5, 2026 against Sharabutdin 'Shara Bullet' Magomedov, but as of Nov 5, 2026 MMA Fighting and Sherdog still called it a rumor that the UFC had not confirmed.
status.ranking: #9 middleweight on the UFC media rankings updated Nov 3, 2026 (CBS Sports; ufcalendar.com mirror); #10 on the UFC/Meta algorithmic rankings updated Oct 31, 2026 (ufcalendar.com)
status.next_fight: Reported, not confirmed by the UFC as of Nov 5, 2026: vs Sharabutdin 'Shara Bullet' Magomedov (17-1), five-round main event, UFC Fight Night 295, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Dec 5, 2026 (first reported by Ariel Helwani on Oct 15; listed on Sherdog's fighter page and Wikipedia; not on ESPN's UFC schedule).

signature: layered feints with a low lead hand, the jab hidden behind them (Sherdog Film Room; Fight Primer)
counter punching against aggressive opponents (UCSD Guardian; Fight Primer)
calf and lead-leg kicks (battered Pyfer's calf in R1, Mar 2026; reddened Whittaker's lead leg)
kicks and knees at range: knee to the head and body attacks vs Pyfer
right hand at distance: KO of Alex Pereira, R2, UFC 287 (Apr 2023)
weaknesses: grappling exchanges: submitted by Du Plessis (RNC, R4, Aug 2024) and finished by Pyfer on the ground in R2 (Mar 2026; reported as a back take, ufcstats lists punches from mount at 4:18)
sustained forward pressure: Strickland dropped him in R1 and won 49-46 on all cards (Sep 2023)
three straight stoppage losses; KO'd by Imavov's right hand 30 seconds into R2 (Feb 2025)
takedown defense down to 72% decayed from 76% career, with opponents shooting about 5 times per fight (decayed 21.4 attempts over 4.1 fight-weights)
style.summary: A long switch-stance kickboxer who wins on feints, distance and counters, attacking the legs and body from the outside. He keeps winning first rounds on output (20-8 vs Imavov, 24-9 vs Pyfer) and then gets finished. His last three losses were all stoppages, from punches, ground strikes and a choke.

moves.notes: Target groups follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 67.7% head, 15.5% body, 16.8% leg (career 67.9/14.5/17.6). The middleweight league split is about 77/14/9, so he sends roughly twice the league share to the legs. He also lands 95% of his sig strikes at distance, so clinch and ground weights stay minimal. Inside the head group, sources stress the feinted jab and counter punching, which puts the jab first and the cross and hooks next. Head kicks get 0.18 because he is a kickboxer by trade, though no source in this pass counts them. Body is weighted to kicks because his body work comes from range (26/29 body landed vs Du Plessis, 38/60 vs Strickland; 92 of his 97 sig vs Du Plessis and all 94 vs Strickland landed at distance). Calf leads inside on the legs, since Pyfer coverage describes him 'battering' the calf. The knee is set at 0.1 for the knee to the head vs Pyfer. Spinning is a small 0.06 judgment, not sourced in this pass.

appearance.build: very tall and slim (6'4", 80" reach per dataset): long limbs, narrow waist, lean torso with visible abs (ESPN cutouts, Aug 2024 and Mar 2026)
appearance.hair: short black hair: a short tight-curl crop on top with faded sides (ESPN headshot and cutout dated Mar 27, 2026; UFC Seattle face-off and fight photos, Mar 2026). The Aug 2024 cutout shows the same short crop.
appearance.facial_hair: essentially clean-shaven: at most a faint thin moustache and a little chin hair (ESPN headshot, Mar 2026; fight photo, Mar 28, 2026)
appearance.tattoos: Seen in the Mar 2026 ESPN cutout and headshot: 'BROKEN NATIVE' in large letters across the upper chest under the collarbones; a map of Africa on the sternum; dark ink on both sides of the neck; heavy work on both arms (the right arm is largely covered from shoulder to forearm); a piece on the abdomen. Identifications from tattoo write-ups (not checked against photos piece by piece): Lagos highlighted on the Africa map, yin-yang inside a Kurama seal on the abdomen, Deadpool on the left ribcage, Toph Beifong (Avatar) on the right inner forearm, Calvin and Hobbes on a bicep, and a neck piece most reports identify as the Egyptian war god Montu. Small face tattoos near the eye and eyebrow were reported in 2024, but sources disagree on placement and none are legible in the Mar 2026 headshot, so leave them off the avatar.
appearance.kit: Vale tudo-cut compression shorts to mid-thigh, not board shorts: a navy snakeskin-print UFC kit with gold lightning trim in both the Aug 2024 and Mar 2026 ESPN cutouts (gold gloves for the 2024 title fight, black UFC gloves in 2026). Red wrist tape at UFC Seattle (Mar 2026 fight photo). A small stud earring in the left ear at the Mar 2026 face-off.
appearance.notes: No photo-based likeness sheet exists for him (checked data/likeness on Nov 6, 2026). The hair, facial hair and kit lines come from viewing the ESPN/UFC studio photos (headshot and left cutout dated Mar 27, 2026; right cutout Aug 16, 2024) and the reference photos in assets/reference/israel-adesanya/ (Cageside Press face-off, Mar 27, 2026; Sky Sports fight photo, Mar 2026).

engine_notes.note: Wins R1 on volume, then gets finished in R2: he led Imavov 20-8 and Pyfer 24-9 in sig strikes in R1 and was stopped in R2 both times.
Three KO/TKO losses on his record (Pereira 2022, Imavov 2025, Pyfer 2026) plus the Du Plessis submission. Decayed opponent sig accuracy is 48.5% against him, up from 44.2% career.
Almost no offensive grappling: 0.06 takedowns per 15 min decayed, 3% control share. Opponents hold 14% control share against him.
In five-round fights, output in R2-R5 runs 1.18-1.44x R1 across 15 such fights, so he starts measured.
